facts.fact: The Central Bank of Nigeria's Payments System Supervision Department issued Circular PSS/DIR/PUB/CIR/001/004 on 15 June 2026 requiring banks, fintechs and other licensed payment operators to store and manage payment transaction data generated in Nigeria in Nigeria, with full compliance due 1 January 2027 and the CBN saying that date has not changed.
facts.system: CBN payment data localisation directive (Circular PSS/DIR/PUB/CIR/001/004)

facts.fact: The CBN, which issued the circular for the payment institutions it licenses, says it will monitor compliance and may impose supervisory sanctions, though the circular sets no penalty schedule (reported 8 October 2026).
facts.system: CBN payment data localisation directive (Circular PSS/DIR/PUB/CIR/001/004)
